desktop.notes:
• One Publish... button (bottom right) replaces Export / Set as wallpaper / Slideshow / Virtual desktops.
• Publish: per desktop choose Colour, Wallpaper (a set) or Slideshow (sets + interval), tick which desktops to update, then Publish. Unticked desktops keep what they have, slideshows included.
• Without virtual desktops, Publish sets the wallpaper or starts the Windows slideshow.
• Export images, Set as wallpaper and the Windows slideshow are still in the ☰ menu (Ctrl+E, Ctrl+P = Publish).
